observed: Even wsl --version in 1.2 produced the no-installed-distributions error, so its readiness check could not pass.
root_cause: Invoke-Native quoted every argument. WslClient.cpp WslMain uses helpers::ParseArgument with default HandleQuotes=false and compares raw tokens to management switches. The token containing quotes around --version does not equal --version and falls through to Linux command launch, which requires a default distro.
fix: Central command-line builder leaves nonempty arguments without whitespace/quotes unchanged and quotes/escapes only arguments requiring it. Both management and --exec calls use the corrected builder. Resolve the native Windows system wsl.exe explicitly and log management calls plus installer version/bitness.
important_limit: The upstream parser body is compiled and run on Linux. This verifies the root-cause/fix compatibility but does not execute the complete Windows WSL runtime.
